visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of four golden-brown, freshly baked loaves of bread resting on a circular wooden tray lined with newspaper-print paper. The setting is a brightly lit indoor kitchen with natural sunlight streaming through window blinds in the background. (2) A transition shows a metallic mixing bowl containing a smooth, pale yellow ball of dough. A hand reaches into the frame and firmly presses a finger into the center of the dough to check its elasticity, leaving a deep indentation. (3) On a white marble countertop, three separate portions of dough are being manipulated. A pair of hands kneads one piece into a rounded ball while other pieces sit nearby. In the background, a white plastic scraper and a calculator are visible on the counter. (4) The dough is flattened into a rectangular sheet using a white textured rolling pin. A black rectangular baking tin is placed next to the dough to measure its width against the mold. (5) A metal spoon is used to spread cooked red beans over the surface of the flattened dough. Hands then carefully roll the dough from the bottom edge into a long cylinder, encasing the beans. (6) A serrated knife with a red handle makes several diagonal slits across the top of the dough roll. The roll is then placed inside the black baking tin. (7) The bread is seen inside a lit oven, rising and browning. The camera captures the dough expanding past the rim of the tins. (8) The finished bread is sliced using a serrated knife within a pink plastic bread-slicing guide. (9) Finally, a pair of hands pulls a thick slice of the bread apart, showcasing the soft, white fibrous texture of the crumb and the dark red beans embedded within.

(3) The rhythmic, percussive sound of hands slapping and kneading dough against a hard surface is audible, blending with the piano's staccato notes. (4) A distinctive metallic clinking and scraping sound occurs as red beans are spooned from a glass or ceramic container. (5) A sharp, slicing sound with short spectral bandwidth is recorded as a knife cuts into the raw dough, followed by a light thud when the dough roll is placed in a metal tin. (6) A high-pitched digital 'ding' and mechanical oven door sounds are heard, signaling the cooking transition. (7) A sawing, scratchy sound is produced as a serrated knife slices through the baked bread crust within a plastic guide. (8) Finally, a soft, fibrous tearing sound is prominent as the bread slice is pulled apart, accompanied by the final bright cadence of the piano music.
